responsibility: Implements GCC’s inlining decision heuristics and pass orchestration. It contains the early inliner and the whole-program IPA inliner, managing policies such as always_inline, flattening, small-function and recursive inlining, growth and stack limits, edge prioritization, and the pass entry points that schedule inline_transform on chosen functions. This file decides what to inline; detailed cost estimation is delegated to ipa-inline-analysis.cc and body/cgraph rewrites to ipa-inline-transform.cc.
same_name_distinction: Implements the early and IPA inliner pass execution and decision heuristics, including growth-limit checks, flattening, iterative early inlining, and pass registration. Unlike gcc/ipa-inline.h, it is where inline choices are made and scheduled rather than where shared cache types and entry-point declarations are exposed.
